messages:
Maria (eng-ml): quick sanity check — I ran an across-region p50/p95 sweep for llama3-medium int8 on H100 and A100 pools. Routing by edge-proxy vs direct pop looks weird: us-west p95 spikes ~2.5x when routed through proxy, p50 stable. anyone seen a pattern like this?

Jonah (perf): interesting. do you have the raw numbers? p50/p95 + sample qps?

Maria (eng-ml): yeh, ran with small synthetic workload: 50 qps steady, seq len 256. summary:
```
H100 direct (us-east): p50 45ms p95 120ms
H100 proxy-route (us-west via proxy-eu-hop): p50 48ms p95 310ms
A100 direct (eu-west): p50 60ms p95 140ms
A100 proxy-route (us-west via proxy-eu-hop): p50 62ms p95 350ms
```

Anya (research): wow p50 hardly moved, p95 exploded. sounds like tail queuing or a bad hop in the proxy path. did you capture kernel selection logs (which attention kernel used) and batch sizes?

Maria (eng-ml): kernel logs attached inline:
```
[2026-02-14T10:12:01Z] model-serving: kernel=attn_fused_v2 seq=256 batch=1 gpu=H100 kernel_variant=fast_gemm
[2026-02-14T10:12:01Z] model-serving: kernel=attn_fused_v2 seq=256 batch=4 gpu=H100 kernel_variant=fast_gemm
[2026-02-14T10:12:01Z] cache: hit=0 miss=1 route=edge-proxy-usw->euw
```

Tiago (infra): edge-proxy path shows an extra NAT->TLS hop for that customer pop. could be load-shedding or TLS renegotiation causing tail. I can replay TCP traces. Maria, which proxy image tag?

Maria (eng-ml): proxy tag svc/edge-proxy:2026-02-14-canary. also saw occasional 503 in proxy logs at same window.

Samir (sre): heads-up, we had an infra incident at 10:10UTC in eu-west related to proxy autoscaler flapping. might correlate. I'll dig into autoscaler events.

Jonah (perf): another angle — quant int8 on A100/H100 may use different kernels (fast_gemm vs quant_opt). if kernel switches mid-rollout, warmup behavior for KV cache differs and can spike tails. Maria, did you pin model variant?

Maria (eng-ml): pinned model_version=llama3-medium-v1.2-quant-int8. but routing fallback sometimes uses llama3-medium-v1.1-quant-int8-compat which triggers different kernel set.

Anya (research): that could explain p95. variant switching + cold KV cache + proxy hop = compounding tail. can we isolate variables: run H100 direct with variant v1.1 and v1.2, then H100 proxy with both variants?

Maria (eng-ml): doing that now. quick results in ~5m. current plan:
- 5m H100 direct v1.2 (baseline)
- 5m H100 direct v1.1
- 5m H100 proxy v1.2
- 5m H100 proxy v1.1

edge-bot: canary deploy detected: svc/edge-proxy -> tag 2026-02-14-canary (initiator: infra-autodeploy).

Tiago (infra): replaying tcpdump on proxy shows sporadic 120ms TLS handshakes for new downstream connections when concurrency spikes >80. looks like connection pool exhaustion + new TLS handshakes cause occasional long tail.

Maria (eng-ml): quick update from experiment:
```
H100 direct v1.2: p50 46ms p95 125ms
H100 direct v1.1: p50 50ms p95 130ms
H100 proxy v1.2: p50 49ms p95 320ms
H100 proxy v1.1: p50 52ms p95 340ms
```
So variant change doesn't explain the proxy tail fully. proxy path is the dominant factor.

Jonah (perf): confirms hypothesis: proxy-side tail. Recommend: 1) increase keepalive pool, 2) pin proxy canary off for this pop, 3) enable prefix KV warmup for cold starts. Also measure end-to-end hop latencies with traceroute/mtr.

Samir (sre): rolling back proxy canary for us-west now. 2-min rollback in progress.

Tiago (infra): rollback done. monitoring p95.

Maria (eng-ml): post-rollback quick numbers: H100 routed via default path (no canary): p50 47ms p95 130ms. good improvement.

Anya (research): we should add a small synthetic tail probe in our daily bench that hits proxy paths with intermittent new connections to detect TLS handshake-induced tails. Also track kernel-selection drift per request.

Jonah (perf): agreed. I'll open a short PR to add a 'edge-tail' test (seq=256, bursty qps) and capture per-token latencies + route metadata.

Maria (eng-ml): thanks — followups: Tiago to add connection-pool metrics to proxy dashboards, Jonah to add edge-tail bench + kernel logging, Anya to add kv-warmup experiment. label me on any PRs. :thumbsup:

Samir (sre): noted. leaving a pointer to the short replay script Maria used:
```
# replay load
wrk -t8 -c50 -d300s -s ./scripts/seq256_send.lua --latency http://proxy-usw.edge.redwood/api/v1/generate
```

Maria (eng-ml): thanks everyone. saving artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/2469123456-edge-sweep/ — logs + perf csv + kernel traces. I'll link after upload.

Anya (research): great thread. this one shows how routing + infra can dominate model kernel tuning. we should add a short blurb in onboarding docs about isolating infra vs model causes.

Maria (eng-ml): will do. end of thread.
